name: Keep asynchronous flows cancellation-aware and non-blocking
statement: Use Task-returning asynchronous APIs end to end, propagate CancellationToken through I/O and orchestration boundaries, and do not block on tasks with Result, Wait, or GetAwaiter().GetResult().
rationale: Non-blocking, cancellation-aware flows avoid thread starvation and allow review runs to stop cleanly. Quality Studio passes cancellation through sensors, agents, file I/O, and job execution.

goodExample.code:
public async Task<Review> RunAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken) =>
    await client.LoadAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);

history.change: Initial async-hygiene rule grounded in Quality Studio's cancellation-aware review pipeline.
